summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of FlowCRM. 23/23 pytest backend tests pass (auth cookie+bearer, seeded data counts, CRUD on all resources, dashboard stats, CSV import/export, deal filters, automation triggers on deal create and stage->closed_won). Frontend smoke test via Playwright confirms: login redirect, dashboard KPIs+charts+funnel, 16 companies, deals kanban with 6 cols & 40 cards, drag-and-drop updates stage successfully (Moved to Qualified toast), contacts page with 52 rows + import/export buttons, activities 4 tabs, automations 4 seeded cards + create-new flow adds card, settings page shows admin email.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 706 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, companies, contacts, deals, activities, automations, dashboard) for maintainability.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject cookies with wildcard origin; explicit origins should be configured for production (currently works in preview because frontend uses Authorization Bearer header fallback).
/api/auth/me has no cache-control header — minor; consider adding no-store.
Email validation rejects .test/.local TLDs (pydantic EmailStr uses email-validator strict mode). Documented as test_credentials note only — not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 16 companies, ~52 contacts, 40+ deals, 70+ activities, 4 automations on first start. Verified idempotent (skipped on re-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_flowcrm_backend.py - run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_flowcrm_backend.py -v. Drag-and-drop on kanban requires mouse_down + small initial move (>=6px for @dnd-kit PointerSensor distance) + move to target + mouse_up. Automation cards use data-testid 'automation-card-{id}' (NOT automation-row-). The TEST_E2E_Rule created during frontend test is left in DB - clean up if needed (delete via API).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional defects found this iteration.
